title: The Girls of Penthouse Number Two 1979 Collector's Edition Magazine Special
conditionDescription: Vintage 1979 special. Front cover clean and bright with light edge wear. The black back cover shows heavy surface scuffing and white wear marks (see photo 2). Spine intact, no tears. Complete. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Girls of Penthouse - Number Two, Collector's Edition special issue (1979), original $3.25 cover price. Complete.

Four great Penthouse photographers present sixteen extraordinarily desirable girls.

Back cover: black with the Penthouse three-key logo.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
